title: Green Circle TD
description: Maze tower defense: creeps circle in from four corners to the center, passing every position. TRUE ONLINE MULTIPLAYER (2–4 players): WC3-style lobby with 4-letter room codes, authoritative server, per-player build zones, shared lives. Plus procedural turret + creep graphics, Lv1-3 upgrades and 3-way specializations, auto-advancing waves (Space to stack early), armor-vs-damage matrix including WC3 chaos damage, air-targeting restriction, randomized wave order, distinct creep archetypes, local hot-seat co-op, aura towers, Mint economy tower, interest economy, stackable waves, 1×/2×/3× speed, and 30 escalating waves to a multi-phase boss.
